prompt:
Mobile web page design comp for the Kleaner services page, a bolder super-app service menu where the category menu IS the page structure, shown from the top through the first two groups. Regions in order: (1) slim 64px white header, "kleaner" logo left, menu icon right. (2) Hero: a tall rounded photo card filling most of the width, a cleaner in a navy polo mopping a sunlit condo floor, and BELOW the photo (never on it) the two-line left-aligned headline, short subtext and the two pill buttons "Book now" (filled blue) and "WhatsApp us". (3) A bold service launcher grid directly under the hero: nine rounded icon-and-photo shortcut buttons in a 4-column app-icon grid, small circular photo thumbnails with the service name under each, grouped visually by the four groups, like a super-app home screen launcher, each jumping to its service. (4) "Home cleaning" group starts: a horizontally scrolling carousel of tall rounded photo tiles (Standard Cleaning, Deep Cleaning, Move In / Move Out Cleaning), each with name, one line and a "Book now" pill, the next tile peeking at the right edge. (5) "After renovation" group: two stacked wide rounded rows, photo left square, name and line and "Book now" right. Confident, app-like, thumb-first.

Real content to use, spelled exactly: brand wordmark "kleaner" in lowercase bright blue #0088F8 with tiny tagline beneath. Headline "Your home, our honour." Subtext "Home cleaning, renovation clean-ups, aircond, upholstery and moving across Klang Valley. Pick a service and book." Buttons "Book now" (filled blue #0071D1, white text) and "WhatsApp us". Group pills "Home cleaning", "After renovation", "Specialist care", "Moving". Services: Standard Cleaning, Deep Cleaning, Move In / Move Out Cleaning (home cleaning group); Post Renovation Cleaning, Formaldehyde Removal (after renovation group); Aircond Maintenance, Sofa & Mattress Cleaning, Curtain & Carpet Cleaning (specialist care group); Mover (moving group). Every cleaning service button says "Book now"; Mover says "Get a quote". Photography is realistic: Malaysian condo and terrace homes in Klang Valley, natural daylight, cleaners in plain navy polo uniforms with no logos, no text inside any photo. Icons are thin regular-weight line icons. One accent colour only (Kleaner blue), white and very light cool grey ground, near-black navy text, one soft rounded-corner system, pill buttons. No em dashes, no eyebrow labels above headings, no section numbers, no labels or badges overlaid on photos, no prices, no ratings, no reviews, no stars. Render the web page itself edge to edge at a 390px-wide phone viewport, portrait, no device frame, no browser chrome, no hand.
approval_notes: User chose comp B on 2 Oct 2026. Do not literalize: invented logo tagline (use assets logo), adjectival service lines (write factual ones), Formaldehyde typo.
